config.label: Absolute path to the repository to serve, which must already contain a committed
config.description: Absolute path to the repository to serve, which must already contain a committed .spiderbrain/ folder. Set this: an MCP client's working directory is usually not your repository, and without it the server serves the working directory and reports that no understanding layer was found. Equivalent to passing --root.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Enables the cloud why-layer used by the sb_ask tool. The structural tools work offline without it.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. Base URL of the public brain registry this server consults on the first tool call when the repository has no committed .spiderbrain/ folder. Defaults to https://spiderbrain.ai/registry.

config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. This server implements the MCP OAuth flow (dynamic client registration and PKCE), so a client that supports it can connect with no token: leave this blank. For headless or CLI use, set 'Bearer sb_live_...' with an API key from your Spiderbrain dashboard. Either way the hosted brain requires an existing Spiderbrain account with an uploaded brain.
